retainedDecision.finding: No currently bound source establishes the missing Reverse Gravity interaction. The printed tether, speed reduction, flight suspension, and Strength escape do not determine how Reverse Gravity moves or loads a tethered target.

requiredEvidence.details: An approved rule explicitly covering Reverse Gravity forced upward movement, its applicable test or categorical limits, slack, and stop/stretch/failure/release. Flight suspension alone supplies no such interaction.

A lawful rated assembly with attachment, support, path/slack, load, and custody records; or an explicitly accepted ability rule replacing that assembly and defining its limits. Tether wording alone does not waive ratings.

Documented Giant Killer acquisition/unlock and eligible target, plus source-defined activation action, costs/uses, attack and tier-DC calculation, duration, and interruption treatment. Do not infer U's size/access or import Conjure Rope mechanics.
After the preceding authority exists, a complete witness of movement, support, release/fall, cargo/custody, and retained cost/history. No such witness is currently bound.

requiredOwnerInput: Supply an existing approved operational rule or clarification with exact artifact, hash, pointer, and acceptance record establishing the missing interaction; or

Explicitly authorize new mechanical design and review, stating whether it is intended as a source-rule addition or a TEST_ONLY obligation revision. Design authorization alone does not establish or accept a rule; a separate Director decision is required.
boundary: Another fixture adoption or repeated source search cannot fill this mechanical gap. This ruling authors no mechanic.
